summary: E2E validation of Scouting PDF themes (Dark/Light) + light Leaflet map. All 7 pytest cases PASS (test_scouting_pdf_themes.py: dark/light/default profile-pdf with auth + 401 negative + 404 negative + public dark/light). Frontend: detail-pdf-dark-btn & detail-pdf-light-btn visible in prospect detail, both download valid PDFs (~56KB) and show success toasts 'Ficha PDF (oscura/clara) descargada'. Public page /scouting/p/{share_id} renders public-pdf-dark-btn & public-pdf-light-btn, both download PDFs without any error alert. Map tab: voyager light tiles (cartocdn) loaded (15/15 tiles), canvas background #e2e8f0 (light grey) — map renders CLEAR/colorful, NOT black. Bug #1, #2, #3 from problem statement all confirmed fixed.

test_results_by_feature.backend_profile_pdf_light_auth: PASS — 200, content-type application/pdf, %PDF magic header, light theme legible per prior curl validation
test_results_by_feature.backend_profile_pdf_default_theme: PASS — defaults to dark when no theme param, valid PDF
test_results_by_feature.backend_public_pdf_dark: PASS — no-auth endpoint /api/recruiting/public/{share_id}/pdf?theme=dark returns valid PDF
test_results_by_feature.backend_pdf_unauthorized: PASS — 401/403 when no Authorization header on profile-pdf
test_results_by_feature.frontend_detail_pdf_buttons: PASS — detail-pdf-dark-btn (text 'PDF Oscuro', dark style) + detail-pdf-light-btn (text 'PDF Claro', white style) both visible on prospect detail. Click triggers real download (scouting_test_e2e_prospect_dark.pdf 56884B, _light.pdf 56892B) and shows success toasts.
test_results_by_feature.frontend_public_pdf_buttons: PASS — public-pdf-dark-btn + public-pdf-light-btn visible on /scouting/p/{share_id}, both download valid PDFs with no error alert/toast.
test_results_by_feature.frontend_map_light_tiles: PASS — scouting-tab-map → scouting-map-canvas renders with light voyager tiles. JS audit: bg=rgb(226,232,240) #e2e8f0, 15 leaflet-tile-loaded / 15 total, sample src=https://c.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/18/76968/127718.png. Map looks colorful/clear, NOT black. Marker visible for Colombia-origin prospect; sidebar shows '1 ubicados · 2 total · 1 sin país' with TEST_E2E_Prospect under Colombia.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ _PDF_THEMES table cleanly parameterises colors per theme; _build_profile_html(theme=...) reads from it with safe fallback to 'dark'.
✓ PDF endpoints accept theme as Query(default='dark'); maintains backward compat for existing callers.
✓ ScoutingMap.js uses cartocdn voyager light tiles + #e2e8f0 base + tiles.on('load') gate for 'tilesReady' shimmer — addresses iter_66 cosmetic concern.
✓ ScoutingModule.js detail bar renders two visually distinct buttons (dark slate / white) with proper data-testid and disabled+spinner during pdfLoading.
⚠ recruiting.py is still ~1469 lines. Recommend splitting (pdf.py, alerts.py, contacts.py, map.py) per iter_66 note — no regression, but maintenance cost grows.

⚠ Minor: stats inner color is still hardcoded '#CCFF00' in _build_profile_html (line 1308) regardless of theme; on the 'light' PDF this lime-yellow on light card can look low-contrast vs. T['titlecol']. Consider deriving the accent from theme for the light variant.

⚠ Note: PDF endpoints accept theme as free-form string; if a bogus value is sent it silently falls back to dark. A whitelist (theme in {'dark','light'}) with 400 on invalid values would be slightly cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 flows: detail PDF buttons + public PDF buttons + light map)

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_PDF_Theme_Prospect and deletes it after module. Pre-existing TEST_E2E_Prospect (share_id=cd2df5ada54345e8aa8c0593d41ae728) used for public page UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scouting PDF theme testids: detail-pdf-dark-btn, detail-pdf-light-btn (ScoutingModule.js ~L683-684), public-pdf-dark-btn, public-pdf-light-btn (PublicScoutingProfile.js L63/L67). Backend: GET /api/recruiting/prospects/{pid}/profile-pdf?theme=dark|light (auth) and /api/recruiting/public/{share_id}/pdf?theme=dark|light (public). Default theme=dark. PDF download triggers a real File download in browser — use page.expect_download() to capture. Map tile layer is now cartocdn voyager (light); canvas bg #e2e8f0; shimmer overlay (tilesReady) until first tile load fires.
rca_of_the_issue: All 3 user-reported issues resolved: (1) Map black → switched to cartocdn voyager light tiles + light canvas bg (#e2e8f0) in ScoutingMap.js; (2) PDF download failing in prod → _render_pdf now sets PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers directly, allowing Playwright to launch chromium in the deploy environment; (3) Dark + Light PDF design → _PDF_THEMES table + theme query param wired through both authenticated and public endpoints, with two clearly-styled UI buttons in detail bar and public page.
